item.title: Re: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Introductions Sub-team
item.content:encoded:
Hey there! I've been interested in doing this for quite some time now, so here goes nothing! :)

► Application info
▼ Application info

Why do you want to be a junior staff on Community Outreach?

I would like to join the Community Outreach Team to help people find their way around the sometimes confusing nature of the Wiki and the SCP Universe itself.

I believe that the SCP Wiki is the most impressive collaborative effort even undertaken by people on the internet - a place born out of passion and pure creativity - and I would like to help make this wonderful thing as good as it can possibly be. I've seen too many people get turned-off on being invested in all stuff-SCP after a couple of moments within the community due to confusion about certain parts of it or just a general feeling of being overwhelmed, and I would love to do my best to prevent that sort of events from happening.

I try to be involved in as many community events as I can - from contests to the Art Exchange - I would love to help to organize such. Bringing this massive community together in new ways that would make people excited for all content SCP-wise would be a dream.

How active are you?

I'm active on-site every single day - although my activity is mostly focused during afternoon and evening hours, I try to keep in touch with the community whenever and however I can. Additionally, I am very active on SCP-related Discord servers, such as Dr. Cimmerian's Discord Server, /r/SCPDeclassified Discord Server, and Site-42 Discord Server - I engage with conversations going on in such almost constantly throughout the day. I try to read and give idea/draft critique on the said platform to every single request I can possibly put in my schedule - anyone who wishes to obtain help in any way related to the SCP Universe or writing for such can find it within my DMs or in the mentioned servers by simply @-ing me.

Additionally, I read a lot. Unless I'm really busy (which doesn't happen very often), I try to read almost every single article showing up on the Newly Created Pages thread. I also check up on the O5 Command forums once in a while to see how staff functions since these topics have always interested me.

Thought most of my activity circles around Discord due to its relative ease in access on both PC and mobile, I also try to reply to as many Idea Critique and Draft Critique as I possibly can on-site and on IRC when I have a free day - though I'm not a frequent user of the second platform, whenever I enter it, I am more than happy to help people with their writing and/or questions about the SCP Universe.

How can we contact you? Wikidot, IRC, and/or Discord?

As mentioned previously, the place I'm most active on is Discord - I go there by Kein#5142; when contacted there, I am going to reply within 1-2 hours unless I'm currently sleeping (my timezone is GMT+1). I will also notice all Wikidot messages since I check any and all sent to me regularly. IRC is not really my thing, so it isn't the most efficient place to contact me, but I will pop-in to check things out there once every couple of days.

Edit: I have heavily familiarized myself with IRC since the creation of this message; throughout the next couple of days, I will be trying to implement it as heavily as Discord into my lifestyle, spending equal amounts of time on both platforms.

If there are any more questions, I would be more than happy to clear things up. Thanks for considering me!

[Post blanked as it is no longer needed.]

 
 

Hi, currently I've been interested in joining staff to help out around the site for quite some time. I've had my eyes on a few teams (including CO) and I heard that there was an opening. Here's my application:

Why do you want to be a junior staff on Community Outreach?


As the SCP Wiki becomes more and more popular each day, I anticipate that more and more people will desire to join the site. With that said, at least some of the new users may be a bit nervous in their first interaction with others on-site; needing a friendly face to greet them and answer any questions they may have about the site. As I've been on the site for some time and I talk quite a bit in the IRC chats, I think I'd be a great candidate for helping out the new people on the site with their inquiries or just greeting them in general as I'm pretty good with relating to others.

Looking through the intro thread recently, I've noticed that there aren't that many staff members on the subteam, and with the large number of posts, some can go days without responses and I wish to help solve that problem. In addition to standard responses, I'll also be able to use my knowledge of the site's resources to point specific users in the right direction for parts of the site where they might need to go, but may not be aware of. An example would be a user speaking multiple languages and me informing them of the international branches and how to contribute.

How active are you?


I'm active in both the SCP Wiki itself and the IRC chatrooms daily. I try to post in the forums (mainly the ideas forum) at least once a day. Regarding the wiki, I overall try to make the site a better place by constantly checking .lc to make sure pages (especially SCPs) are properly formatted (i.e. having a rating module, proper title, and Wikiwalk). On posts that don't do particularly well, I try to inform the author of what particular points made me downvote it and what they could improve on. I also am constantly monitoring the forums and reporting things like improperly formatted idea threads to the #site17 channel whenever necessary.

Referring to IRC, I'm connected to all of the public chats 24/7 (I have an upgraded IRCCloud account) and will join in on conversations whenever a topic comes up that I am knowledgeable of. Seeing my IRCCloud status, I would be able to be contacted at any time as I will be notified on my phone whenever pinged allowing for quick and reliable communication.

How can we contact you? Wikidot, IRC, and/or Discord?


Wikidot: Hexick
Discord: Hexick#0001
IRC: Hexick/Hex (I alternate between the two.) Hostmask (lacigam.si.kcixeh|073514diu#lacigam.si.kcixeh|073514diu)

Thank you in advance for your consideration.

Apologies, did not reply correctly, hope that's not counted against me, I'm so sorry for clogging, I understand how annoying it is. I hope you can still consider me.

This is something I’ve been wanting to do for awhile, and hey trying out never hurts, so here I go!

+ Open Application
- Close Application

Why do you want to be a junior staff on Community Outreach?

Well, there are many reasons. First, I believe that a nice and helpful introduction is the best way to warmly introduce people to this whole family we have here. Many people may be confused or overwhelmed by all the different questions they have. I know when I first joined, I was very confused. I misused the forums because I wasn’t aware of all the resources that we available to me. It was no one’s fault exactly, but I hope to be able help to make resources clear to new members of the community.

I find joy in seeing all the potential in the fresh faces of brand new members. I’ve wanted to great people on the introductions thread for the longest time, and I’ve recently begun to do so. Though for nearly a year with some breaks in between, I’ve been giving critique to new authors on the forums and in the IRC chat rooms. I help people on the daily because I find peace and joy in doing good for others. What I truly want to do in the world is help people in any way possible, no matter how big or small.

When I see authors develop their ideas from a seedling to a tree, it makes me happy to see the joy and fun they are having as a member of our community. I try to answers questions of any sort when I can. Often when members are confused as to how exactly something works and they mention this in their ideas and critique thread, I will happily give any resources needed. I believe I could be a valuable member to the team because of activity and my ability to organize and list quick and helpful resources. This wiki is a wonderful place, I would love to help out even more.

How active are you?

I’m not too active on social media anymore, though I can pick up my activity if needed. I have Tumblr, Instagram, and Reddit. As for the site and IRC, I’m very active. My time zone is Central US time, and I’m often on and off from 10:00AM-11:00PM. I’m lurking around the chat and forums a lot.

How can we contact you? Wikidot, IRC, and/or Discord?

You can contact me through Wikidot, and my IRC DianaBerry. I have discord, though I barely check it. But if requested, I can become active once more.

Any other questions you may have for me will happily be answered upon request.

item.title: Re: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Applications OPEN
item.content:encoded:
Why do you want to be on JS for Community Outreach (specifically Seminars Team) and why are you a good fit?

I am a constantly-changing person, who can challenge and test the limits of my peers. I make sure those I help are able to adapt to the situation, depending on what I am helping them with. I constantly draft my dreams on sheets of paper, designing and planning schematics for projects in the future. I think in numbers; everything is technical in my eyes, except people. I see people in an emotional, thoughtful manner, and try my best to see things through their eyes. These two parts of me work in tandem for me to lead. The technical side plans, drafts, thinks, and creates, while the emotionally aware side works with people to get the job done effectively. I believe that to survive, all life must constantly change. Through this, I help people be able to adapt to all situations, and teach them that change is to be welcomed, not feared. I make sure to congratulate everyone for even small accomplishments so that they know that I appreciate their work in helping me, others and themselves. When talking to others, I can easily understand their emotions and figure out the best plan of action for each person. I react quickly to change, and make sure that I meet all expectations and succeed as the best I can be. I'm a quick thinker in math, and in problem solving-both of which are my strong suits. All in all, I make sure that both sides of my brain can effectively and efficiently achieve the tasks I need, given the current limitations and tools, and I use technical parts of my mind to plan, and the emotional side to handle the people. I'm a dependable, loyal person who believes in testing the limits of what we can all do.

How active are you?

I have lots of free time and I will be available after school, on weekends, and sometimes in the middle of the day. I bring my laptop everywhere, with my phone on max notification noises. I don't get much sleep and I'm CDT/CST.

How can we contact you? Wikidot/IRC/Discord

Sky_Loves_You on Wikidot. My IRC name changes based on holidays but my ping word is Sky and I have Sky_Loves_You as my real name. Discord will be given privately but it's the best way to contact me, as I'm ALWAYS on discord.

item.title: Re: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Applications OPEN
item.content:encoded:
The Seminars Team is once more searching for Junior Staff!

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Coming up with and organizing seminars
  • Hosting Wiki Orientations
  • Advertising seminars
  • Moderating #workshop during seminars

Secondary Responsibilities:

  • Taking notes during seminars
  • Keeping Seminar Team resources up to date

Competitive Perks:

  • An experience of staff ongoings, such as policy discussion and other staff shenaningans.
  • The ability to post to the staff site. You won't be responsible for voting or anything but can give your view on policies relevant to Community Outreach.
  • After ~4 months on the team, we are able to nominate you for promotion to fully Operational Staff (which occurs every 4 months). (Note: If we choose not to nominate you, and you're curious why, we will try to be completely open with you about it.)
  • No pressure- if it's not for you, there's nothing forcing you to keep at it.

PLEASE NOTE: The Seminars Team is still new, rapidly growing, and responsibilities and the needs of the team are still changing and expanding. Joining this team allows for the opportunity for you to not only gain responsibility but present new ideas to the team. Being on the Seminars team might require you to interact with high-level staff in a one-on-one setting. Please be aware of this.

If you're interested, please REPLY TO THIS POST with answers to the following questions:

Why do you want to be on JS for Community Outreach (specifically Seminars Team) and why are you a good fit?

How active are you?

How can we contact you? Wikidot/IRC/Discord

item.title: Re: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Applications OPEN
item.content:encoded:
Hiya!

Why do you want to be a junior staff on Community Outreach?

I love participating in this site's development and maintenance. While I am already Licensing J-Staff, I'd really like to branch out into more facets of the site, and seeing as I'm not the best critter, Community Outreach looks like it's the way to go!

I also enjoy the miscellaneous work that comes with being CO, and I tend to be very resourceful and observant when learning new things, or trying to figure out how they work, like when I figured out how to add things to the series archive when ARD needed some hubs added.

As for seminars specifically, I haven't been able to tune into all of them, but from the ones I have, I absorbed some really good tips from the hosts. With enough time and some logs I could definitely whip up a summary. I'm also fairly— ah, wait, I'll save that for the next question!

How active are you?

I tend to be on IRC most of the time during school, which is when I usually do some general staffwork and writing. Here goes:

+ show block
– hide block

Why do you feel you should be a junior staff? Why the Community Outreach team?

I care a lot about this site as a project - I believe that what we're doing here has important implications. It's a prototype on the cutting edge of how reading and storytelling will evolve in the 21st century, and an incredible source of free education, and a lot of other things I could go on about. At the same time, I also care about it as a bunch of welcoming and supportive people who have done a lot for me just by being here and doing this.

I'm interested in contributing to the administration/housekeeping of the project because it's a fascinating and significant thing; I'm interested in contributing to the culture of positivity and acceptance we have as a bunch of people because it's been invaluable to me personally (and is fascinating and significant in its own way). So applying to be community outreach staff makes sense.

I've been junior staff on the forum crit team since mid-October, and I think that's been going well. It's been an honor to be part of a team like this one, and I would love to continue finding uses for the skills I have to offer.

How active are you?

I check the forums (and O5) every day, frequently, though mostly for just a few minutes at a time. I post quite a bit - since I've recently moved far from home, this site's been a major source of social interaction for me, which is one of the reasons I'm so grateful for it. I make it a point to respond when newcomers (or anyone else) are trying to engage with the community, because I remember how good it felt when staff did the same for me.

Which of the responsibilities listed above do you think you would be a good fit for and why?

Posting in the Introductions threads on the forums, responding to new members and directing them to site resources - I do a good bit of this already, for the reasons above. The resources we have here are unique, and it's exciting to see people introduced to them. I've contribited some successful and well-received tales while struggling when it comes to SCP articles themselves, so I can relate to both success and failure in writing here, and even have an extensive skill set related to helping people learn from challenges and frustration rather than give up.

Helping ProcyonLotor with soliciting contest ideas, discussing contests with moderators and admins, and hosting/organizing contests - I think I could be helpful with this; designing and running activities to get people engaged in things is a big part of my job, so it would be interesting to apply that here.

Helping ARD produce the Monthly Site News - On it! I'd say I'm doing a not-perfect-but-pretty-okay job at this so far, and plan to continue; it's a perfect task for me to chip away at bit by bit with my sporadic moments of free time.

Overseeing fan work, art, and projects - I can probably help with this - really, I think the site has a lot of potential to be a learning + entertainment resource for art a lot like it is for writing, and I'd like to help that develop.

Soliciting ways to improve the site and following up on said ideas by talking to people on Tech Team, Internet Outreach, etc. etc. - I'm completely useless on the technology end of things, but coordinating information to help run and improve organizations is something I'm experienced with. I think a lot about the site and how we could do even more with it than we already are, so having regular chances to discuss those ideas with the senior staff would be really exciting.

Thank you for reading all this! The site means a lot to me, and it was nice to have prompts to put some of it into words. Here's to taking it all even further in 2018.
